_note: First-pass English of Saadia's Judeo-Arabic Tafsir on Bereshit 1, drafted to translate the JA directly rather than the biblical Hebrew. Captures Saadia's signature interpretive moves — שא ... אן יכון for ויאמר, עלם for וירא, ריאח for רוח, פכאן for ויהי, צורה for צלם. Marked as draft pending author revision.

translations.1: The first thing God created was the heavens and the earth.
translations.2: And the earth was submerged and sea-like; and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the winds of God blew over the face of the water.
translations.3: God willed that there be light, and there was light.
translations.4: And when God knew that the light was good, He separated between the light and the darkness.
translations.5: And God called the times of light “day,” and the times of darkness “night.” And there passed of night and daytime one day.
translations.6: God willed that there be a firmament in the midst of the water, and that it be a divider between the two waters.
translations.7: And God made the firmament, and separated between the water which is below it and the water which is above it. And so it was.
translations.8: And God called the firmament “sky.” And there passed of night and daytime a second day.
translations.9: God willed that the water gather, from beneath the sky, to one place, and that the dry land appear. And so it was.
translations.10: And God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of the water “seas” — for God knew that this was good.
translations.11: God willed that the earth bring forth verdure: grass bearing seed, and tree bearing fruit, producing fruit according to its kinds, whose seed is in itself, upon the earth. And so it was.
translations.12: And the earth brought forth verdure: grass bearing seed according to its kinds, and tree producing fruit whose seed is in itself, according to its kinds. For God knew that this was good.
translations.13: And there passed of night and daytime a third day.
translations.14: God willed that there be luminaries in the firmament of the sky, to separate between day and night, that they may be signs and seasons, days and years.
translations.15: And let the luminaries be in the firmament of the sky to give light upon the earth. And so it was.
translations.16: And God made the two great luminaries — the greater luminary for giving light in the day, and the lesser luminary for giving light in the night — and the stars.
translations.17: And God set them in the firmament of the sky, to give light upon the earth,
translations.18: and to give light in the day and the night, and to separate between the light and the darkness. For God knew that this was good.
translations.19: And there passed of night and daytime a fourth day.
translations.20: God willed that there move forth from the water moving creatures possessing living souls, and bird that flies above the earth, facing the firmament of the sky.
translations.21: And God created the great sea-creatures, and all the living, creeping souls which moved forth from the water, according to their kinds, and every winged bird according to its kinds. For God knew that this was good.
translations.22: And God blessed them, and said decreeing: “Bear fruit and multiply, and fill the water which is in the seas; and let the bird multiply upon the earth.”
translations.23: And there passed of night and daytime a fifth day.
translations.24: God willed that the earth bring forth living souls according to their kinds — beasts and creeping things and the wild creatures of the earth according to their kinds. And so it was.
translations.25: And God made the wild creatures of the earth according to their kinds, and the beasts according to their kinds, and every creeping thing of the earth according to its kinds. For God knew that this was good.
translations.26: God said: “Let us make a human in our form, after our likeness, sovereign — that they may rule over the fish of the sea, and the bird of the sky, and the beasts, and the whole earth, and every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.”
translations.27: And God created Adam in His form, sovereign He created him; male and female He created them.
translations.28: And God blessed the two of them, and said to them: “Bear fruit and multiply, and fill the earth and master it; and rule over the fish of the sea and the bird of the sky and every living thing that creeps upon the earth.”
translations.29: And God said: “Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed which is upon the face of the whole earth, and every tree wherein is fruit bearing seed — these shall be for you as food.
translations.30: And to every wild creature of the earth, and bird of the sky, and all that creeps upon the earth in which is a living soul — all green herbage shall be for food.” And so it was.
translations.31: For God knew that all that He had made was very good. And there passed of night and daytime a sixth day.
